races.verdict: Time has already shown SEA LANTERN faced a really stiff task conceding chunks of weight to a pair of upwardly-mobile 3-y-os in a 1¼m novice here back in the spring. That was his best effort yet and with the return to further a plus on handicap debut, Brian Ellison's charge looks to have plenty going for him returning from a break. Traveling Man and Morbeh can offer up chief resistance, in that order. SEA LANTERN TRAVELING MAN MORBEH

He's the one to beat if translating that to turf at the fourth time of asking, with improving 3-y-o Tarmonbarry Kid likely to prove a serious danger. Orangesandlemons , Second Fiddle and Runninsonofagun are others to consider in a competitive handicap. HAVANA TOUCH TARMONBARRY KID (IRE) ORANGESANDLEMONS

races.verdict: This looks wide open and with that in mind it could pay to take a chance on MINSTREL KNIGHT . He's been absent since shaping as if amiss at Thirsk back in the spring but with easier ground in his favour from what appeals as a handy mark, he may represent a spot of value with his yard enjoying a really productive season.
